summary: Jin Medical International Ltd. (a Cayman Islands company) filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a VIE Control Master Acquisition Agreement dated September 8, 2026. Through its subsidiary Erhua Med, the company will obtain contractual control and economic benefits of Huaxia Qiying (the Target), a Chinese firm holding ginseng-related biological and R&D assets. Consideration is $159,415,729, payable via issuance of 71,282,488 Class A ordinary shares (par value $0.001). The Target lacks a commercial business; acquisition supports expansion into senior-health platform. Closing is subject to conditions including Nasdaq notification, due diligence, and no PRC legal impediments. The transaction is structured as VIE agreements, not legal equity transfer; voting and economic rights vest via contracts. What to watch: potential PRC regulatory review and post-closing integration risks.
